fields.name: user
fields.help: Your Nova Engel dropshipping web-service user (issued with the approved dropshipping account).

fields.name: password
fields.help: The password of that web-service user.

config_fields.name: language
config_fields.help: Language code for product texts in the URL path, e.g. es, en, fr, it, pt or de (the {language} segment of /api/products/…).

me.note: Logs in (POST /api/login {User, Password} → Token) and reads one catalogue product with the session token in the path: verifies the credentials.

list_products.note: GET /api/products/paging/{token}/{pages}/{elements}/{language}: one page of the catalogue (Id, EANs, Description, Price = your cost ex-VAT, PVR = recommended retail price, Stock, brand, families). `query`/`category` are not applied — the API has no search; brands are listed with /api/products/brand.

create_order.note: POST /api/orders/sendv2/{token} with one ClientOrderModel. `items`: up to 10 lines [{product_id: Nova Engel product Id, quantity}]; `shipping_address`: {order_number (your unique reference), name, second_name, street, city, county, postal_code, country, telephone, mobile, carrier_notes?, valoration? (declared value)}. Answers OrderNumber, BookingCode, Message and Errors[]. `shipping_option` is not applied.

get_order.note: GET /api/orders/orderbyid/{token}/{id}: OrderModel (Status code 0–12, Total, Date, Invoice, SendInfo tracking, Lines). `status` is the numeric Status code as a string (the vocabulary types status as a string).

track.note: The order's SendInfo (TrackingModel: Tracking, Carrier, Expedition, TrackingURL) as the single entry of `events` (the vocabulary requires an events array); the API has no tracking-event history, and the order Status code stays in raw of get_order.

not_offered.get_product: The Swagger (https://drop.novaengel.com/swagger/docs/v1) has no single-product call: products come only in lists (/api/products/paging, /availables, /offers, /brand/{id}) and /api/products/image/{token}/{id} returns just an image.
not_offered.quote_shipping: No shipping-quote operation exists in the Swagger (https://drop.novaengel.com/swagger/docs/v1); orders are sent with /api/orders/sendv2 and charges appear afterwards on the OrderModel (Charge1, Charge2).

adapter.terms: Nova Engel dropshipping Web API (Swagger 'eCommerce.DropShipping.WebApi' v1). Every call except /api/login carries the session Token as a URL path segment; the runtime logs in again on 401. Business accounts only (deposit and yearly purchase target, per https://www.novaengel.com/dropshipping_productos).

evidence: host drop.novaengel.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GoDaddy.com, Inc.)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (public), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://drop.novaengel.com/swagger/docs/v1: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: The token travels in the path; an invalid token gets HTTP 200 with empty data rather than an error, and create_order reports 'Unrecognized user, please login again' inside a 200 array, which no envelope rule can catch. Fixed: get_order status as a string and track events as an array (vocabulary).
